headword: {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}

definitions.explanation: An urgent notification issued to warn the public of imminent danger such as earthquakes, tsunamis, severe weather, or other emergencies.

examples.japanese: {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: An emergency alert arrived on my smartphone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{土砂災害|どしゃさいがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An emergency warning was issued due to the risk of landslides caused by heavy rain.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧ (emergency; urgent) and ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ (warning; alarm). In Japan, the {緊急警報放送|きんきゅうけいほうほうそう} (Emergency Warning Broadcast System) and {緊急地震速報|きんきゅうじしんそくほう} (Earthquake Early Warning) are well-known systems that send alerts via television, radio, and smartphones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧: an emergency alert sounds
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: an emergency warning is issued
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive an emergency alert
- {緊急警報|きんきゅうけいほう}⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: Emergency Warning Broadcast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: warning; alarm — the general term for any official warning, not necessarily urgent
- {緊急地震速報|きんきゅうじしんそくほう}: Earthquake Early Warning — a specific system that alerts people seconds before shaking arrives
- {避難警報|ひなんけいほう}: evacuation warning — specifically instructs people to evacuate
